analysis:
MARKET REGIME: SPY is in a confirmed broad downtrend (-5.4% vs SMA50, slope -1.17%). This is the single most important input today. Quality-value strategies experience their deepest drawdowns in market-wide selloffs, not name-specific ones. Deploying more capital into this environment would be disciplined violation, not opportunity-seeking.

PORTFOLIO REVIEW:
- ULTA (+4.57%, $28.9k): Largest position, holding well. Not in screened candidates this cycle — monitor whether trend filters have changed, but no thesis-break evident from price action.
- UHS (+7.56%, $19.2k): In screened candidates, uptrend basing confirmed, thesis intact. EPS revisions -4.8% is a mild flag worth watching next earnings (Jan 2026 est). No action needed.
- ADSK (+2.41%, $12.3k): Small gain, thesis intact. Not in screened candidates — verify trend status hasn't deteriorated.
- FOXA (-1.13%, $11.9k): Slight loss, within normal noise. Not in screened candidates. Keep stop discipline in place.
- AMP (-7.70%, $9.6k): This is the most concerning position. Down 7.7% from avg cost of $547.12, now $504.99. AMP did NOT appear in this cycle's screened candidates, suggesting it may have failed trend or quality filters. At -7.7% the position is approaching meaningful loss territory. Recommend checking whether original stop has been hit or is close — if AMP is in a confirmed downtrend per filters, the thesis may be broken. Flag for immediate stop review.

CAPACITY: 85% deployed in 5 positions. Only ~$10k headroom remains before hitting the 95% gross cap. This is insufficient to size even a half-sized position properly (a 15%-stop position needs ~$5k risk buffer minimum, meaning position size ~$33k at 1.5% equity risk — well above remaining headroom). Proper sizing is impossible without first reducing existing exposure.

NEW TRADES: Zero. Three overlapping reasons: (1) Market downtrend — most screened candidates are fighting the tide; (2) Capacity exhausted — $10k headroom cannot support a properly-sized new position; (3) Several candidates extended well above SMA50 (APP +21.4%, PNR +21.3%) violating entry timing rules, and high-range-position names (LLY 91%, HST 88%, CBOE 82%) exceed the 80% threshold. The most attractive basing setups (NOC at 29% 52w range, ZTS at 23%) are overshadowed by the macro downtrend. Sitting in cash and monitoring is the highest-quality action available today. The Sortino of -10.46 signals the current book is generating negative risk-adjusted returns — adding to that pressure is contraindicated.
